correctness.rationale: Independent conditional-uniform root split and subtrees give exact recurrences for mean maximum-key path length, mean leaf count and their product. Correct boundaries n=1,2 and strict signs n>=3. Exact rational recursion checked sizes 2..160 and exhaustive independent construction through n=9; finite experiments not used as a universal proof.

originality.rationale: Compared the exact cross-statistic (rightmost/root-to-largest-key length versus global outdegree counts), including equivalences to record count and edge-depth, against accessible historical claims, an actual indexed database search and closely related full primary papers. Holmgren–Janson covers outdegree and fringe statistics but not this mixed extreme-key path result in inspected statements; Bóna–Pittel measures rank from leaves. Distinct roles of the two observables prevent marginal or within-fringe covariance statements from implying the claim. Priority remains qualified by possible older implicit mixed record/leaf coverage.

value.rationale: Joint dependence between extreme-key lookup cost and the full node-degree profile is a motivated search-tree shape/performance question. The exact sign profile separates leaves and branching nodes from unary nodes at every nontrivial finite size, and finite nonzero limiting cross-covariances contrast with decaying correlations. The mixed leaf/path moment supplies an explicit benchmark not inferred from classical separate marginals; other degree identities are not separately valorized.
